DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 行程のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss your itinerary?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人は速く歩きますが、私は途中で休みたいです。別々に行くつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩く速さが違う同行者との行程を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend walks fast, but I would like to take breaks along the way. We were planning to go separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss an itinerary with a companion who walks at a different pace. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 途中で確実に合流できる場所は決めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you decided on a place where you can be sure to meet up along the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。乗り物の時間だけ合わせれば会えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 合流未定と便だけ合わせた考えを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I thought we could meet as long as we coordinated the departure time of our transport.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not decided where to meet and had only planned to coordinate your transport. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 移動時間が違うと、同じ便に乗れない可能性があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: If your travel times differ, you may not be able to catch the same service.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、友人と同じ速さで無理に歩かず、休む時間込みで一緒に計画します。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩込みの共同行程へ変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will plan together with my friend, allowing time for breaks, rather than forcing myself to walk at the same pace.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Change to a shared itinerary that includes breaks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日進める範囲も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's also check how far you can go today.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 最後まで行くことより、二人で戻れる時間を優先したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見学完遂より共同帰着を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to prioritize a time that lets us both get back, rather than going all the way to the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prioritize returning together over completing the entire visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻る便の候補を先に見ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Shall we look at possible return services first?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。帰りの候補から逆に、見学する場所を絞りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰路時刻から見学範囲を絞ると提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I would like to work back from the return options and narrow down the places we visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Suggest narrowing down the places to visit based on return departure times. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 帰りの時刻と現地の状況を確認しましょう。その上で、お二人の行程を組み直せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's check the return times and local conditions. Then we can revise the itinerary for both of you.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 傘のお問い合わせですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about an umbrella, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この透明な傘に似ていますが、同じ物を使う人が多いので自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: よく似た傘でも本人の物か不確かと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It looks like this transparent umbrella, but many people use the same kind, so I am not sure.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that even though the umbrella looks very similar, you are unsure whether it is yours. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自分で付けた目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is there any identifying mark you added yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持ち手に青い糸を巻いていました。先端ではなく、手をかける曲がった部分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 青い糸の正確な位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had wound blue thread around the handle. Not the tip, but the curved part you hold.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the exact location of the blue thread. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その部分を確認します。

DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 糸がなければ、私の物だとは言えません。勝手に持ち帰らずに待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目印がなければ受取を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: If the thread is missing, I cannot say it is mine. I will wait rather than take it home without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put off collecting it if the identifying mark is missing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに覚えている特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you remember any other distinctive features?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 留めるボタンが少し緩いです。ただ、それだけでは決められないと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 補助的なボタンの状態を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: The fastening button is a little loose. But I do not think that alone is enough to decide.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the condition of the button as an additional clue. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認用紙にもその二点を記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please write those two details on the verification form too.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。青い糸を主な目印にして、ボタンの状態も書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 主な特徴と補助特徴を用紙に記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will list the blue thread as the main identifying mark and also describe the button's condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write the main identifying feature and the additional feature on the form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 用紙で特徴を照合します。確認が取れるまで、傘はこちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will compare the features against the form. We will keep the umbrella here until it has been verified.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内の利用についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about using the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鳥の声を録音したいのですが、近くの人の会話まで入りそうで迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鳥声録音への他人の会話混入を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to record birdsong, but I am unsure because nearby people's conversations might be recorded too.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about other people's conversations being captured in a birdsong recording. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 人に近づいて録音するのは避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please avoid approaching people to make recordings.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。鳥を追わず、今いる場所で短く録るつもりです。静かな場所を探して移ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 鳥を追わない短時間録音と移動を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I intend to record briefly where I am now, without following the birds. May I look for a quiet place and move there?
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Propose a brief recording without following birds and moving to another spot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 立入りできる範囲で、通路をふさがないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please stay within areas open to visitors and avoid blocking the paths.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 通路を外れた広い所を使います。周りに人が来たら録音を止めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通路を避け人が来たら録音停止すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will use a spacious spot away from the path. If people come nearby, I will stop recording.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will avoid the paths and stop recording if people come. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 録った音は公開する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you plan to make the recording public?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ決めていません。会話が入った部分は、そのまま公開しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会話混入部分の公開を控えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not decided yet. I will avoid publishing any sections containing conversations as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will refrain from publishing sections containing conversations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 鳥に近づくために植込みへ入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do not enter the planted areas to get closer to birds.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。遠くの声を録れなければ、今日は音を聞くだけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 接近が必要なら録音を諦める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. If I cannot record the calls from a distance, I will just listen today.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give up recording if it requires getting closer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 無理に近づかず、園路からお楽しみください。周囲に配慮した利用をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy them from the park paths without forcing your way closer. Please be considerate of those around you.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 停留所のご確認ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。案内が聞き取れませんでした。メモにある停留所はもう過ぎましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 聞き逃した停留所が過ぎたか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I could not make out the announcement. Have we already passed the stop on my note?
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the stop whose announcement you missed has already been passed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メモを見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me the note?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これです。似た名前が聞こえたので、慌てて降りそうになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 似た名前で早く降りかけた事情を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I heard a similar name and nearly got off in a rush.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that hearing a similar name almost made you get off too early. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ先です。次の表示にも注意してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is still ahead. Please pay attention to the next display too.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: よかったです。音声だけでなく、表示の漢字も見て待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 漢字表示も併用して待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's a relief. I will wait while checking the kanji on the display as well as listening to the announcements.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will wait while also checking the kanji display. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 降りる準備は停車してからお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait until we have stopped before preparing to get off.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今は座ったまま荷物をまとめます。降り口はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 座って準備し降り口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. For now I will gather my belongings while remaining seated. Which exit should I use?
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prepare while seated and ask which exit to use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 前方の降り口です。停車後に進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: The exit at the front. Please move towards it after we stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。停留所名を確認してから、前へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停留所確認後の移動を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will check the stop name before moving to the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will move after checking the stop. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その停留所が近づいたら表示をご確認ください。停車してから落ち着いてお降りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the display as that stop approaches. Once we stop, take your time getting off.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お味はいかがでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し濃く感じます。全部を変える前に、少量で試す方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 全体変更前の少量試食を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: It tastes a little strong to me. Is there a way to try a small amount before changing the whole dish?
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about tasting a small portion before changing the whole dish. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 取り分け用の小さい器をお持ちできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can bring you a small bowl for a separate portion.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。そこでスープの味を確かめてから、調整できるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小器で確認後の調整相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I would like to check the soup's taste in it and then ask whether it can be adjusted.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to discuss adjustments after checking the taste in a small bowl. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 調整をご希望なら、厨房へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you would like it adjusted, I will check with the kitchen.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分で水を丼へ入れず、まずお店の方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己判断で水を足さず店へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Rather than adding water to the main bowl myself, I will first ask how the restaurant handles it.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check with the restaurant rather than adding water on your own judgment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 麺の量も減らしたいということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you also want fewer noodles?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ。量はそのままで、スープの濃さだけ相談しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 量変更と濃さ変更を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I want the quantity to stay the same; I am only asking about the strength of the soup.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish changing the quantity from changing the soup's strength. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。小さい器を先にお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I will bring the small bowl first.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。試してから、薄めたいか改めて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 試食後に希望を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. After trying it, I will let you know again whether I want it diluted.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain your preference after tasting it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの器でお試しください。調整のご希望が決まったら、厨房に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please try it in this bowl. Once you have decided what adjustment you want, I will check with the kitchen.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 交代前の確認は済みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished the checks before the shift change?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 工具の返却で数が合いません。記録は四本ですが、箱には三本です。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 工具の記録と実数の不足を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: The count does not match when returning the tools. The record says four, but there are three in the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a shortage between the recorded tool count and the actual count. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 不足に気づいた時点で、誰かに伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you tell anyone when you noticed the shortage?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。使った人を決めつけず、先に責任者へ報告したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 使用者を断定せず責任者へ連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I would like to report it to the person in charge first, without assuming who used it.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Contact the person in charge without deciding who used the tool. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に確認した場所はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you know where you last checked them?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 休憩前に作業台で四本見ました。その後の持出しは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最後に見た事実と未確認の持出しを分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I saw four on the workbench before the break. I did not see anyone take any away after that.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate what you last saw from the unverified removal of a tool. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一人で現場内を探し回らず、担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check with the person responsible rather than searching around the site alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。引継ぎに「返却済み」と書かず、一本確認中と記します。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 引継ぎを返却完了でなく確認中にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Instead of writing 'returned' in the handover, I will write that one tool is being checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Record the handover as being checked rather than fully returned. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見つかった場合も報告が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: You need to report it if it is found too.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。見つかった場所と時刻を添えて、記録を更新してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見後の場所時刻報告を約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will give the location and time it was found and have the record updated.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Promise to report the place and time if it is found. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認中として引き継ぎます。責任者の指示を待ち、不明なまま返却完了にしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will hand it over as still being checked. Wait for the supervisor's instructions and do not mark the return as complete while it remains unresolved.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 画面の表示についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss what is shown on the screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。残高と利用可能額が違います。どちらを見て支払いを考えればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残高と利用可能額の表示差を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The balance and available amount are different. Which should I look at when planning a payment?
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between the displayed balance and available amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 差の理由は口座の内容を確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the account details to determine the reason for the difference.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、残高が多いから全部使えるとは考えず、確認をお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残高全額を使えると推測せず確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I would like you to check, rather than assuming I can use the entire balance because it is larger.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a check without assuming you can use the whole balance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの取引を予定していますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家賃の支払いです。今日実行できるか知りたいですが、ここでは金額を大声で言いたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家賃取引と金額の非公開希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: A rent payment. I want to know whether it can be made today, but I do not want to say the amount out loud here.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the transaction is a rent payment and you want to keep the amount private. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 用紙に書いて担当へお見せいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can write it on a form and show it to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。口座番号と予定額を、この用紙に記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相談情報を用紙で提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will write my account number and the planned amount on this form.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the information for the consultation on a form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本人確認書類もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you also have identification with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。表示の意味と支払い可否を確認するまで、送金操作はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人書類提示と送金操作保留を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not make a transfer until I have checked what the display means and whether the payment can be made.
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will present identification and hold off making a transfer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者が確認します。用紙と本人確認書類をお持ちの上、こちらの相談席へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-016-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: The person in charge will check. Please bring the form and your identification to this consultation seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人に荷物を渡したいんですが、私はここから別の列車に乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別の列車に乗る待合せ事情を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to give my friend some luggage, but I am taking a different train from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are meeting someone but will take a different train. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 友人は今どちらにいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 改札の外です。私もまだ入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人の改札位置を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Outside the ticket gates. I have not gone through them yet either.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say where both of you are in relation to the ticket gates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では改札に入る前に会えますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then you can meet before going through the gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きな荷物があるので、通路をふさがない場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物で通行を妨げない場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have large luggage. Is there somewhere we will not block the passage?
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a place where your luggage will not obstruct people. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内所の横なら、入口を避けて待てます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Beside the information desk, you can wait away from the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこにいると連絡します。友人の切符もこの袋に入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 合流連絡と切符の所在を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will let my friend know I will be there. My friend's ticket is also in this bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain contacting your friend about where to meet and where the ticket is. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 渡すときに切符を忘れず取り出してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do not forget to take out the ticket when handing it over.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 切符を先に分けてから、二人の乗り場を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切符の分離と乗り場確認を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will separate the tickets first and then check the boarding locations for both of us.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to separate the tickets and check the boarding locations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それなら慌てずに済みますね。横でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: That way you will not have to rush. Please wait at the side.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何を描いていらっしゃいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手前の枝と奥の木です。絵では同じ太さに見えてしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 絵での遠近表現の問題を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The branch in the foreground and the tree in the background. They end up looking equally thick in my drawing.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain a problem with showing perspective in your drawing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際には、ここからどう見えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: How do they actually look from here?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手前の枝が大きく見えます。木そのものの大きさとは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見える大きさと実物の大きさを分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The branch in the foreground looks larger. That is different from the size of the tree itself, isn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish apparent size from actual size. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 少し離れると、重なり方も変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you move a little farther away, the way they overlap changes too.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の位置をメモして、別の位置からも見てみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二つの観察位置を比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will note my current position and try looking from another position too.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare two observation positions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路の内側からご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please observe from within the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。植込みには入らず、ここで小さい下絵をもう一枚描きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 観察可能な場所で第二の下絵を作る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will stay out of the planted areas and draw another small sketch here.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make a second sketch in a place where observation is permitted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二枚の違いが分かりそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you think you can see the difference between the two drawings?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 枝の重なりが変わりました。最初の下絵を残し、二枚目を仕上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 比較結果で仕上げる絵を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: The way the branches overlap has changed. I will keep the first sketch and finish the second one.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose which drawing to finish based on the comparison. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 観察位置を比べられましたね。続きを楽しんでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have been able to compare observation positions. Enjoy continuing your drawing.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内板をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for an information board?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が全部昔の建物だと言ったんですが、この説明と違う気がします。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 説明の食い違いを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend said all of these were old buildings, but I feel that differs from this explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out a discrepancy between explanations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの建物についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which building are you referring to?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 目の前の建物です。「復元」という言葉の意味を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 復元という語の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The building right in front of us. I would like to check what the word 'reconstruction' means.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask what the word 'reconstruction' means. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元の姿を資料などから再現したという意味です。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: It means recreating the original appearance using historical materials and other sources.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、昔の建物がそのまま残っているとは書かないほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元の建物と再現を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I should not write that the old building has survived unchanged, should I?
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the original building from a recreation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。この板の記述と分けて考えるといいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. It is good to distinguish that idea from what this board says.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 建てられた時期も、板に書かれた日付を写しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日付の根拠を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will also copy the date on the board to record when it was built.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear the source for the date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 名称も一緒にメモすると混同しにくいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you note the name too, it will be harder to confuse it with something else.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。友人にも、推測だった部分を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者への訂正を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will also tell my friend which parts were assumptions.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to give your companion a correction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご一緒に案内板を確かめてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the information board together.
